publication.title: WISP: Weighted shortest paths for RDF graphs

source_reading.scope: Identity, weighting schemes and interface, index/benchmark setup, complete human study/results and conclusion/materials (§§4–7).

adjudication.basis: WiSP implements entity-pair path search and recommends explanatory RDF paths using node/edge weighting. A ten-person comparative path-interest study and separate runtime experiments supply evidence, with low agreement and slower full-graph responses limiting general claims.

studies.cohort_note: Cross-report participant overlap is not established.
studies.design: Wikidata truthy2017-06-07graph,7 weights and scaled subgraphs; two100-pair query sets
studies.results: Full graph: 25,081,334 nodes/89,878,092 edges; means/medians>27s, weighted slowest near1min. Small graph: 1,227,382 nodes/6,603,412 edges used for interactive demo; reported2–4s.

studies.cohort_note: Cross-report participant overlap is not established.
studies.response_note: 81query evaluations,79 complete,553 path scores; not81/79/553 users.
studies.design: Within-query comparison of7weighted path outputs against unweighted shortest-path baseline
measures: Seven-point path-interest ratings, Kendalltau-b, paired t-tests
studies.results: Low mean inter-rater tau=.201; severalweighted variants rated higher than baseline. Concordant subset8 pairs/tau=.552 selectively analyzed.
limitations: Subjective interest, small expert sample and repeated judgments; no controlled exploration-time benefit. Text says27 concordant evaluations while figure captionn28; do not synthesize an exact combined denominator.

descriptions.interaction: Select source/target entities via prefix completion, choose optional weighting scheme and inspect diagrammatic weighted shortest path.
descriptions.guidance: ["Degree/PageRank/edge-frequency hybrid weighted path selection", "Prefix entity completion", "Explanatory connections between query entities"]
descriptions.visualisation: ["Directed labelled path diagram", "Study version displays all7weighting results for one query on one page"]
descriptions.backend: RDF graph mapped to integer/labelled-neighbour in-memory index and offline weight dictionary
